evidence.note: Setup/payoff lands: climb → 'Hitman snaps off missile dropkick — Hall takes 19 damage' plus 'Hall is rattled — when they're forced up, big payoffs may open.' Distinct Big swing intents on the top rope.
Groggy cash-in is real: menu offers 'Vertical suplex 77% — TARGET GROGGY payoff: heavy damage is available now' vs Collar-and-elbow 92%; aggressive takes the suplex for 16 damage.
Mid-match Finish swing: with Hall grounded at 105 HP, Cover + Sharpshooter 70% are offered; player fires Sharpshooter and gets 'Hall turns the tables!' — risky finish attempt with a clear miss beat.
Second big spot: both on TOP_ROPE → 'Hitman snaps off superplex — Hall takes 30 damage' and rattled again. Brief peril after both go GROUNDED (player fails get_up at t23) before the close.

Climax is a clean pin after hip toss + failed Hall get_up; gates_passed and turn_count 33 inside [8,40]. Collar appears often (aggressive) but grapple_counter/break resolve quickly — not a long collar slog. Missing near-fall (near_fall_count 0) keeps this from a 5.
Pin is Finish index 1 whenever legal (also t33). curation_pin_visible true — Cover never hidden.
Sharpshooter labeled '70% — cash in momentum for a match-ending swing' reads as apply-hold odds in the Finish lane (88% again at t33), not a win meter.
Groggy is clearly a modifier: 'Hall rises — still groggy from the impact!' with position STANDING and groggy [false, true].
TARGET GROGGY payoff note makes the heavy line unmistakable above the safer tie-up.
Minor: grapple chip notes say 'whip out to break the cycle' but curated menu only shows Hip toss / Arm drag / Side headlock / Climb / Recover — whip itself is not listed among choices.
Early Sharpshooter reversal invites a rematch that commits to Cover instead when Hall fails get_up (t10/t32).
Clean 1-2-3 with finish_sequence delays leaves curiosity about a kickout/near-fall beat that never fired (near_fall_count 0).
Superplex + dual-ground sequence is a line worth replaying with different Finish timing.

stickiness.rematch_reason: Match had real setup/payoff variety and a pin climax inside the turn band; want to see a kickout or submission path instead of a first-try 1-2-3.
stickiness.next_experiment: Re-run seed 219 taking Cover at t11 (or after the t32 failed get_up) aiming for a near-fall, or cash Sharpshooter at t33 to compare submission finish_sequence tension vs the clean pin.

evidence.note: Missile dropkick + rattled line is a clear crowd-pop state shift (Hall 124→105, GROUNDED).
Superplex 30 damage + rattled, both wrestlers GROUNDED — highest-impact offense of the match.
Pin finish_sequence stages delays_sec 1.0 then 1.5 before the three: 'Referee: 1… / 2… / 3! *** PINFALL — Hitman wins ***'.
Failed get-ups telegraph cover heat ('still down and vulnerable to a cover!') at t10 and t32 — paid off by the pin, but no kickout beat so near_fall_count stays 0.
log_uniqueness_ratio 0.7105 supports varied phrasing; collar/chip lines repeat some but big spots stay distinct.

top_issues.summary: Finish is a clean first-attempt 1-2-3 with near_fall_count 0 despite two prior 'vulnerable to a cover' teases (t10/t32). Buildup is good; the kickout beat never appears.
top_issues.suggested_area: pin kickout frequency / near-fall staging when opponent is mid-HP or first cover

top_issues.summary: When grappled, chip-throw notes tell the player to 'whip out to break the cycle' but Irish whip is not among curated choices (only hip toss / arm drag / side headlock).
top_issues.suggested_area: curation: surface whip (or remove whip language from chip notes)

top_issues.summary: Aggressive policy still leans on Collar-and-elbow (six player uses) though counters/breaks exit quickly and move_repetition_rate 0.3529 is tolerable inside 33 turns — soft loop tax notes do not strongly deter re-entry.
